column3: “gems” specifies the stones as precious stones.
“an ostrich” is singular rather than plural.
“to help her” supplies a purpose for the hands.
“dignitaries” interprets the consecrated ones as high-ranking people; “rubies” renders the comparison with corals.
“dared” specifies inability as lack of daring.
“punishment” renders guilt through its punishment; “prolong your exile” replaces taking you into exile again.
